title: Spatial Analysis of Fire: Archaeological Approach to Recognizing Early Fire
lineage: Cited passage inspected; retained file is a brief paraphrased research note.

passages.locator: Spatial Analysis and Fire at Gesher Benot Ya‘aqov
passages.note: The author interprets spatial clusters of burned flint and repeated occupation horizons as evidence for repeated controlled fire, approximately 0.78–0.79 million years ago. Phantom hearths lack constructed hearth features.
